description: This PHP class 'EmployeeDao' manages database operations related to Employee entities in an HRM system. It includes methods for fetching lists of employees, counting, saving, deleting, and checking employee data, as well as handling hierarchical relationships like supervisors and subordinates.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Employee entities, providing methods to query and manipulate employee data, including hierarchical relations like supervisors and subordinates.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Returns a list of employees based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers matching specific filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds the Doctrine QueryBuilder with applied filters based on search parameters.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an Employee entity by employee number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpNumbers
methods.description: Checks which employee numbers exist among a list of IDs.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Recursively retrieves subordinate employee IDs under a supervisor.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the total number of employees, optionally excluding terminated.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Returns a list of subordinates for a given supervisor, optionally including the chain.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if a given employee number corresponds to a supervisor.

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Fetches the reporting method between subordinate and supervisor.

methods.name: getEmpNumberList
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers, optionally excluding terminated employees.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees based on provided employee numbers.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Recursively retrieves supervisor IDs for a subordinate.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Fetches work shift information for a specific employee.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeeListForWorkShift
methods.description: Returns employees available for shifting (not assigned to a shift).

methods.name: getEmailList
methods.description: Retrieves all employee email addresses.

methods.name: isEmailAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an email address is already used by any employee.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies if an employee ID is unique within the system.
